on this occasion we extenu to you our near-

tiest thanks for selecting and purchasing our HINOMOTO Model MB-140 4-Wheel Tractor. Owing to our customers' strong patronage, our HINOMOTO 4-wheel tractors have achieved

the top place in Japan's total annual production

of compact tractors.

The HINOMOTO tractors are now actively

working on the farms in not only their Japanese

homeland but also Southeast-Asiatic countries,

Canada, Australia, European countries, and even the U.S.A., the cradleland of farm tractors. Wherever they go they are highly acclaimed for their very superior features. The MB 140 tractor which you have just pur-

chased has been very painstakingly designed, and it is a unique tractor which absolutely precludes imitations by other makes of tractors. We are fully confident that its superior per-

formance and ease in handling will always

satisfy you. Furthermore, utmost consideration has been

given to the matter of enabling the user to carry on all kinds of farming operations most effici-

ently and enjoyably, making use of the wide range of our highly efficient, economical and

unique attachments.

This Instruction Manual is intended to give

you a better understanding of the working, care and maintenance of the MB 140 tractor. We ask

you to study it thoroughly, and to become a first-class technician in its operation. We wish

you a long and happy service from this tractor.
